analogy.rationale: These cells express little NR3C2, so mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists should produce minimal transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other nuclear receptor ligands (agonist at the same receptor, androgen receptor antagonists, glucocorticoid receptor agonists) and calcium channel blockers, since several MR antagonists also block L-type/T-type calcium channels.
